newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stork sees orders picking up in H2 1996.
newsitem.headline: Stork sees orders picking up in H2 1996.

text.p: Stork NV said on Wednesday it expected to make up for an eight percent decline in first-half turnover during the second half of the year.
First half turnover fell to 1.41 billion guilders from 1.53 billion.
"Turnover in the first half of 1996 was at a relatively low level of 1,413 million guilders which we expect to make good in the second half of the year," Stork said.
Stork said it had received new orders in the first 32 weeks of 1996 worth 2.466 billion guilders -- 466 million guilders less than in the same period of 1995.
It said this was partly due to the sale of units such as Stork Contiweb, Stork Refac and Sutherland-Schultz which together generated about 250 million guilders a year in orders.

Stork said it had recently concluded three multi-year deals with globally operating customers. These orders had a combined value of over one billion guilders but were not included in the published figures for orders received so far this year, it said.
